teacher_info.intro:
🎉 Hi there! I’m your go-to English tutor, here to make learning as fun and effective as possible! 🎉


🌍 A bit about me: I’m a native English speaker with over 3 years of online teaching experience! 💃 Originally from Zambia and now living in South Africa (24+ years) 🇿🇲🇿🇦, I’m also a Biotechnology graduate👩‍🔬.


Here’s what you can look forward to in my classes: ✨ I’m patient, chatty, and always bring good vibes—learning with me is fun, friendly, and NEVER boring! ✨ Think of me as your relatable, chatty teacher, ready to guide you with expert conversational skills and engaging material. We'll have lively discussions, learn something new every day, and make amazing memories together!

course_info.trial_description: In this session, I will outline what types of lessons you can expect from me, and what study materials I have available and use for your lessons. The main goal is for me to get to know what your goals are, and for us to establish a suitable learning strategy for you. For me to be able to gauge your proficiency in reading, we'll take a short reading test, then we can plan your lessons accordingly.

pro_course_detail.title: Want To Improve Your Conversation Fluency?
pro_course_detail.description:
As we engage in different conversations, I will guide you when necessary for improvement. If you want to improve your speaking and/or presentation skills, this lesson is for you. You may select from a list of topics, but feel free to think of your own topics based on your own interests.  



Resources:

1. PDF of different topics

2. Comprehension (Reading and discussing)

3. Talking about life in general, main your interest



Come on let's have fun while you learn English!

pro_course_detail.title: Interview practice & Resume (CV) Editing
pro_course_detail.description:
I can help you land your dream English job if you take my class. 


Your CV will be edited by me, and I will make it as clear as possible in English. You will learn all the possible questions you may encounter in an interview about your personality and work ethic in this lesson. 


As a result, you will:

1. Leave a lot more confident about your responses to your interview questions.

2. Leave with a pdf document of all the possible interview questions and answers to accompany them. 

3. A well written resume (CV)


I would appreciate if you could send me your CV (preferably as a word document) at least 24 hours prior to the class. In class, we'll discuss all the changes that I believe should be made to it to make it sound as crisp as possible. 




Emergencies are also acceptable, but please let me know.

pro_course_detail.title: Document Editing
pro_course_detail.description:
This class/session is for working professionals who need to edit some documents.

I charge by the hour, and it can be done in the absence of your presence. 

Send me a message if you need any more details.
